name: Storm Harry
headline: Cut-off low over Iberia stalled for a week.

sections.The trigger: Cut-off low over Iberia stalled for a week.
sections.What amplified it: 206 mm in Tunisia, ~10 m waves off Spain; boats capsized after leaving Sfax.
